cases.name: sealed-product
cases.extra: public sealed class P{public int a; public int b; public P(int a,int b){this.a=a;this.b=b;}} public class Q{public P p; public Q(P p){this.p=p;}} public class Box<T>{public T value; public Box(T v){this.value=v;}}

cases.name: sealed-field
cases.pre:
sealed type P={a:int, b:int}
type Q={p:P}
cases.cs: var q=new Q(new P(3,4)); return q.p.a+q.p.b;
